subhero.en: Humira's list price is $6,922 per month in 2026. Eight FDA-approved adalimumab biosimilars are now marketed in the United States, with cash prices ranging from approximately $550 to $3,744 per monthly carton. All eight carry the FDA interchangeable designation, meaning pharmacists can substitute them for Humira without a new prescription in most states. Medicare Part B covers provider-administered adalimumab under HCPCS J0139 at ASP+6% (approximately $23.16 per mg). AbbVie's myAbbVie Assist patient assistance program stopped accepting new Humira applicants on July 1, 2026. Here is what each biosimilar costs, how formularies compare, and how to navigate the switch.
subhero.es: El precio de lista de Humira es $6,922 por mes en 2026. Ocho biosimilares de adalimumab aprobados por la FDA estan comercializados en Estados Unidos, con precios en efectivo que van desde aproximadamente $550 hasta $3,744 por carton mensual. Los ocho llevan la designacion de intercambiable de la FDA, lo que significa que los farmaceuticos pueden sustituirlos por Humira sin una nueva receta en la mayoria de los estados. Medicare Parte B cubre el adalimumab administrado por un proveedor bajo HCPCS J0139 a ASP+6% (aproximadamente $23.16 por mg). El programa de asistencia al paciente myAbbVie Assist de AbbVie dejo de aceptar nuevos solicitantes de Humira el 1 de julio de 2026.

quickAnswer.en: As of 2026, eight FDA-approved biosimilars to Humira (adalimumab) are marketed in the United States: Amjevita, Cyltezo, Hadlima, Hulio, Hyrimoz, Simlandi, Yuflyma, and Abrilada. All eight share Humira's indications for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, plaque psoriasis, and related inflammatory conditions. All eight carry the FDA interchangeable designation. Cash prices range from approximately $550 per month (unbranded adalimumab-adbm via GoodRx) to $3,744 per month (Simlandi) at retail pharmacies. Medicare Part D plans in 2026 overwhelmingly prefer biosimilars over brand Humira on formulary. Switching from Humira to a biosimilar typically requires a prior authorization update, and your plan may mandate the switch under step-therapy policy. Patients who lose coverage for Humira should apply to individual biosimilar manufacturer assistance programs, since AbbVie's myAbbVie Assist PAP closed to new Humira applicants in July 2026.
quickAnswer.es: A partir de 2026, ocho biosimilares aprobados por la FDA de Humira (adalimumab) estan comercializados en Estados Unidos: Amjevita, Cyltezo, Hadlima, Hulio, Hyrimoz, Simlandi, Yuflyma y Abrilada. Los ocho comparten las indicaciones de Humira para artritis reumatoide, artritis psoriasica, espondilitis anquilosante, enfermedad de Crohn, colitis ulcerosa, psoriasis en placas y condiciones inflamatorias relacionadas. Los ocho llevan la designacion de intercambiable de la FDA. Los precios en efectivo van desde aproximadamente $550 por mes (adalimumab-adbm sin marca via GoodRx) hasta $3,744 por mes (Simlandi) en farmacias minoristas. Los planes Medicare Parte D en 2026 prefieren abrumadoramente los biosimilares sobre Humira de marca en el formulario. El cambio de Humira a un biosimilar generalmente requiere una actualizacion de autorizacion previa.

introParagraphs.en: Humira (adalimumab) was the world's best-selling drug for more than a decade. AbbVie's US patent fortress finally opened in 2023 when the first biosimilars entered the market. By 2026, eight distinct adalimumab biosimilars are marketed in the United States: Amjevita (Amgen), Cyltezo (Boehringer Ingelheim), Hadlima (Samsung Bioepis/Organon), Hulio (Mylan/Fujifilm), Hyrimoz (Sandoz), Simlandi (Alvotech), Yuflyma (Celltrion), and Abrilada (Pfizer). Two additional biosimilars, Yusimry (Coherus) and Idacio (Fresenius Kabi), have FDA approval but are not among the eight primarily active in the 2026 commercial market. All eight share Humira's approved indications and the same active molecule, adalimumab, a human IgG1 monoclonal antibody targeting tumor necrosis factor.
introParagraphs.es: Humira (adalimumab) fue el medicamento mas vendido del mundo durante mas de una decada. La fortaleza de patentes de AbbVie en EE.UU. finalmente se abrio en 2023 cuando los primeros biosimilares entraron al mercado. Para 2026, ocho biosimilares de adalimumab distintos estan comercializados en EE.UU.: Amjevita (Amgen), Cyltezo (Boehringer Ingelheim), Hadlima (Samsung Bioepis/Organon), Hulio (Mylan/Fujifilm), Hyrimoz (Sandoz), Simlandi (Alvotech), Yuflyma (Celltrion) y Abrilada (Pfizer). Los ocho comparten las indicaciones aprobadas de Humira y la misma molecula activa, adalimumab, un anticuerpo monoclonal IgG1 humano que actua sobre el factor de necrosis tumoral.

introParagraphs.en: All eight actively marketed biosimilars carry the FDA interchangeable designation: Amjevita, Cyltezo, Hadlima, Hulio, Hyrimoz, Simlandi, Yuflyma, and Abrilada. Abrilada (Pfizer) received its interchangeable designation from the FDA on October 5, 2023. The interchangeable designation allows pharmacists in most states to substitute a biosimilar for brand Humira at the pharmacy counter without a new prescription from the prescriber. The FDA's interchangeable standard requires that the biosimilar can be expected to produce the same clinical result as the reference product in any given patient, and that switching between the reference product and the biosimilar does not increase safety or efficacy risks compared to using the reference product without switching. Patients on Medicaid typically pay $1 to $4 in copays for biosimilar adalimumab when it is on formulary. The full list of FDA-approved biologics and biosimilars is maintained in the FDA's Purple Book database at purplebooksearch.fda.gov.
introParagraphs.es: Los ocho biosimilares activamente comercializados llevan la designacion de intercambiable de la FDA: Amjevita, Cyltezo, Hadlima, Hulio, Hyrimoz, Simlandi, Yuflyma y Abrilada. Abrilada (Pfizer) recibio su designacion de intercambiable de la FDA el 5 de octubre de 2023. La designacion de intercambiable permite a los farmaceuticos en la mayoria de los estados sustituir un biosimilar por Humira de marca en el mostrador de la farmacia sin una nueva receta del prescriptor. Los pacientes con Medicaid generalmente pagan de $1 a $4 en copagos para adalimumab biosimilar cuando esta en el formulario.

introParagraphs.en: Despite significant biosimilar competition, Humira's 2026 list price of $6,922 per month has not meaningfully declined. AbbVie relies on rebate arrangements with pharmacy benefit managers to maintain Humira's formulary position at some plans while biosimilar manufacturers compete on net price. From a cash-pay standpoint, the savings are dramatic: unbranded adalimumab-adbm (Cyltezo's active ingredient) is available through GoodRx at approximately $550 per carton, a 92 percent discount from Humira's list price. For patients covered by Medicare Part D, the 2026 annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100 applies, and most 2026 Medicare Part D formularies place biosimilar adalimumab at Tier 1 or Tier 2 while excluding brand Humira or placing it at Tier 5. The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, which established the $2,100 Part D cap, has particularly benefited high-cost biologic users who previously faced catastrophic-phase cost-sharing above $7,000 per year.
introParagraphs.es: A pesar de la significativa competencia de biosimilares, el precio de lista de Humira en 2026 de $6,922 por mes no ha disminuido de manera significativa. AbbVie se basa en acuerdos de descuento con los gestores de beneficios de farmacia para mantener la posicion de Humira en el formulario en algunos planes, mientras los fabricantes de biosimilares compiten en precio neto. Desde el punto de vista del pago en efectivo, los ahorros son dramaticos: el adalimumab-adbm sin marca esta disponible a traves de GoodRx a aproximadamente $550 por carton, un descuento del 92% sobre el precio de lista de Humira. Para los pacientes cubiertos por Medicare Parte D, aplica el limite anual de gastos de bolsillo de 2026 de $2,100, y la mayoria de los formularios Medicare Parte D de 2026 ubican el adalimumab biosimilar en el Nivel 1 o Nivel 2 mientras excluyen Humira de marca o lo ubican en el Nivel 5. La Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022, que establece el limite de $2,100 de la Parte D, ha beneficiado especialmente a los usuarios de biologicos de alto costo.

paragraphs.en: Medicare pays approximately $1,853 per month for a standard two-dose adalimumab regimen using J0139 (2 doses of 40mg x 40 units x $23.16/mg). Michigan price transparency data published by the Michigan Health Purchasers Coalition shows commercial payer rates at facilities in the same metropolitan area ranging from under $2,000 to over $15,800 for the identical monthly treatment cycle. The more than $11,000 spread within one metro area is not a difference in drug quality or patient safety. All FDA-approved adalimumab biosimilars use the same active molecule, carry the same approved indications, and are billed under the same J0139 code. The price variation reflects facility markup structures, not therapeutic differences.
paragraphs.es: Medicare paga aproximadamente $1,853 por mes para un regimen mensual estandar de adalimumab de dos dosis usando J0139. Los datos de transparencia de precios de Michigan muestran tarifas de pagadores comerciales en instalaciones de la misma area metropolitana que van desde menos de $2,000 hasta mas de $15,800 para el mismo ciclo de tratamiento mensual. La diferencia de mas de $11,000 no es una diferencia en calidad del medicamento o seguridad del paciente. Todos los biosimilares de adalimumab aprobados por la FDA usan la misma molecula activa y llevan las mismas indicaciones aprobadas.

paragraphs.en: Hospitals apply facility rates that bundle drug acquisition cost with nursing administration, pharmacy handling, storage, and system-wide overhead allocations. For a high-cost biologic like adalimumab, facility markups above the Medicare ASP can reach 4x to 8x. Academic medical centers with high commercial payer volume routinely bill adalimumab at rates that exceed the Medicare ASP by 500 percent or more. The patient's share at 20 percent coinsurance means a patient at a high-markup outpatient facility could owe more than $3,000 per monthly injection cycle compared to $370 at a facility billing near the Medicare ASP. When a biosimilar is administered but a higher-priced brand is billed, that is a billing error. Each biosimilar has its own ASP rate published in the CMS quarterly files, and claims should reflect the product actually administered.
paragraphs.es: Los hospitales aplican tarifas de instalacion que agrupan el costo de adquisicion del medicamento con administracion de enfermeria, manejo de farmacia, almacenamiento y asignaciones de gastos generales de todo el sistema. Para un biologico de alto costo como el adalimumab, los recargos de la instalacion sobre el ASP de Medicare pueden llegar a 4x a 8x. La participacion del 20% del paciente en coseguro significa que un paciente en una instalacion de alto recargo podria deber mas de $3,000 por ciclo mensual de inyeccion comparado con $370 en una instalacion que factura cerca del ASP de Medicare.

paragraphs.en: Choosing where to receive the injection matters as much as choosing the drug. Hospital price transparency rules require most facilities to publish negotiated rates, though compliance and enforcement remain inconsistent. If you receive adalimumab in a clinical setting, ask your rheumatologist or gastroenterologist whether a lower-cost infusion suite, independent outpatient clinic, or home self-injection is clinically appropriate. Most adalimumab biosimilars are formulated for home self-injection via prefilled pen or syringe, which eliminates facility fees entirely and subjects the drug only to the pharmacy channel pricing shown in the table above.
paragraphs.es: Elegir donde recibir la inyeccion importa tanto como elegir el medicamento. Si recibe adalimumab en un entorno clinico, pregunte a su reumatolo o gastroenterologo si una suite de infusion de menor costo, una clinica ambulatoria independiente o la autoinyeccion en casa es clinicamente apropiada. La mayoria de los biosimilares de adalimumab estan formulados para autoinyeccion en casa, lo que elimina completamente las tarifas de instalacion.

intro.en: Adalimumab administered in a clinical setting (doctor's office, infusion suite, hospital outpatient department) is billed under HCPCS Level II J-codes. Effective January 1, 2025, CMS deleted J0135 (injection, adalimumab, 20mg) and replaced it with J0139 (injection, adalimumab, 1mg). Both brand Humira and biosimilar adalimumab products administered in a clinical setting are billed under J0139. The unit difference matters: under J0135, a 40mg dose was billed as 2 units; under J0139, a 40mg dose is billed as 40 units. Any claim using J0135 for a date of service on or after January 1, 2025 is using an invalid code and should be corrected.
intro.es: El adalimumab administrado en un entorno clinico se factura bajo los codigos J de nivel II de HCPCS. Efectivo el 1 de enero de 2025, CMS elimino J0135 y lo reemplazo con J0139 (por 1mg). Tanto Humira de marca como los biosimilares de adalimumab administrados clinicamente se facturan bajo J0139. Una dosis de 40mg = 40 unidades de J0139 (no 2 unidades como bajo J0135).

description.en: Injection, adalimumab, 1mg (active code effective January 1, 2025; replaces deleted J0135)
description.es: Inyeccion, adalimumab, 1mg (codigo activo efectivo 1 de enero de 2025; reemplaza a J0135 eliminado)

whatToLookFor.en: Standard 40mg dose = 40 units of J0139. Medicare ASP ~$21.85/mg; ASP+6% ~$23.16/mg. Cost per 40mg dose at Medicare rate: ~$927. Applies to brand Humira, all biosimilars. If you see J0135 on a 2025 or 2026 bill, that is a billing error: request correction and resubmission.
whatToLookFor.es: Dosis estandar de 40mg = 40 unidades de J0139. ASP de Medicare ~$21.85/mg; ASP+6% ~$23.16/mg. Costo por dosis de 40mg a tarifa Medicare: ~$927. Si ve J0135 en una factura de 2025 o 2026, es un error de facturacion.

description.en: Injection, adalimumab, 20mg (DELETED January 1, 2025: invalid for any 2025 or 2026 date of service)
description.es: Inyeccion, adalimumab, 20mg (ELIMINADO el 1 de enero de 2025: invalido para fechas de servicio de 2025 o 2026)

whatToLookFor.en: If J0135 appears on your Explanation of Benefits for any date of service in 2025 or 2026, this is a billing error. The correct code is J0139. Contact your provider to correct and resubmit the claim to Medicare or your insurer.
whatToLookFor.es: Si J0135 aparece en su Explicacion de Beneficios para cualquier fecha de servicio en 2025 o 2026, este es un error de facturacion. El codigo correcto es J0139. Contacte a su proveedor para corregir y reenviar.

footnote.en: HCPCS Level II codes are published annually by CMS. J0139 applies to all adalimumab products (brand and biosimilar) when administered in a clinical setting. Each biosimilar product has its own ASP payment limit published quarterly in the CMS Part B Drug Pricing files. Verify the unit count on your bill: 40mg dose = 40 units, 80mg dose = 80 units.
footnote.es: Los codigos HCPCS Nivel II son publicados anualmente por CMS. J0139 aplica a todos los productos de adalimumab (marca y biosimilar) cuando se administran en un entorno clinico. Cada biosimilar tiene su propio limite de pago ASP publicado trimestralmente.

intro.en: AbbVie's myAbbVie Assist patient assistance program stopped accepting new Humira applicants on July 1, 2026, because of biosimilar availability. Patients who were enrolled in myAbbVie Assist for Humira before that date can complete their current eligibility term but cannot renew for Humira. For patients starting adalimumab therapy in 2026, each biosimilar manufacturer operates its own assistance program. The HUMIRA Complete savings card remains available for commercially insured patients and reduces monthly copays to $0, but federal law bars its use with Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA benefits. Patients without commercial insurance should apply directly to the biosimilar manufacturer's patient assistance program for the specific product their provider prescribes.
intro.es: El programa de asistencia al paciente myAbbVie Assist de AbbVie dejo de aceptar nuevos solicitantes de Humira el 1 de julio de 2026 debido a la disponibilidad de biosimilares. Los pacientes inscritos en myAbbVie Assist para Humira antes de esa fecha pueden completar su termino de elegibilidad actual pero no pueden renovar para Humira. Para pacientes que inician terapia de adalimumab en 2026, cada fabricante de biosimilar opera su propio programa de asistencia. La tarjeta de ahorros HUMIRA Complete sigue disponible para pacientes con seguro comercial, pero la ley federal prohibe su uso con Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA.

rows.program: HUMIRA Complete Savings Card (AbbVie, commercially insured patients only)

costBenefit.en: $0/month copay for eligible commercially insured patients; up to $14,000/year covered by the card. Not available with Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA coverage per federal anti-kickback law.
costBenefit.es: $0/mes de copago para pacientes elegibles con seguro comercial; hasta $14,000/ano cubierto por la tarjeta. No disponible con Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA segun la ley federal anti-sobornos.

rows.program: myAbbVie Assist PAP (AbbVie, uninsured/underinsured; closed to new Humira applicants July 1, 2026)

costBenefit.en: Free Humira for uninsured or underinsured patients at or below 600% FPL (approximately $95,760/year for a single person in 2026). Closed to new applicants since July 1, 2026. Existing patients may continue their current term only.
costBenefit.es: Humira gratuito para pacientes sin seguro o con seguro insuficiente en o por debajo del 600% FPL (aproximadamente $95,760/ano para una persona en 2026). Cerrado a nuevos solicitantes desde el 1 de julio de 2026.

rows.program: Boehringer Ingelheim (Cyltezo / unbranded adalimumab-adbm) GoodRx Program

costBenefit.en: Unbranded adalimumab-adbm (same molecule as Cyltezo) available via GoodRx at approximately $550 per 2-pen carton, a 92 percent discount from Humira's list price. Available at more than 70,000 participating retail pharmacies. No income requirement for cash-pay program.
costBenefit.es: Adalimumab-adbm sin marca disponible via GoodRx a aproximadamente $550 por carton de 2 plumas, un descuento del 92% frente al precio de lista de Humira. Disponible en mas de 70,000 farmacias participantes.

rows.program: Organon/Samsung Bioepis Hadlima Patient Support Program

costBenefit.en: Hadlima (adalimumab-bwwd) is an interchangeable biosimilar marketed by Organon. Savings programs and copay cards available; employer plan average approximately $1,038/carton. Contact Organon specialty pharmacy support for eligibility and income-based assistance.
costBenefit.es: Hadlima (adalimumab-bwwd) es un biosimilar intercambiable comercializado por Organon. Programas de ahorros y tarjetas de copago disponibles; promedio de plan de empleador aproximadamente $1,038/carton.

rows.program: PAN Foundation (independent copay grants for Medicare patients with rheumatology/GI/derm conditions)

costBenefit.en: Grants for Medicare patients with rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, and related conditions; covers copays, coinsurance, and deductibles for Part B and Part D. Eligibility is income-based and fund-dependent.
costBenefit.es: Subvenciones para pacientes de Medicare con artritis reumatoide, psoriasis, enfermedad de Crohn, colitis ulcerosa y condiciones relacionadas; cubre copagos, coseguro y deducibles. La elegibilidad se basa en ingresos y disponibilidad de fondos.

rows.program: HealthWell Foundation (Medicare Part B and Part D copay assistance)

costBenefit.en: Grants for Medicare beneficiaries with Part B or Part D cost-sharing for rheumatology, gastroenterology, and dermatology conditions. Grant amounts vary by fund availability; apply early in each calendar year as funds are limited.
costBenefit.es: Subvenciones para beneficiarios de Medicare con coseguro de Parte B o Parte D para condiciones de reumatologia, gastroenterologia y dermatologia. Los montos de subvenciones varian segun la disponibilidad de fondos.

footnote.en: HUMIRA Complete manufacturer coupon and other manufacturer copay cards cannot be used by Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA beneficiaries. Federal anti-kickback statute (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b) prohibits manufacturer copay assistance for government-insured patients. This is not a plan-level restriction: it is federal law. Medicare patients should seek assistance from PAN Foundation, HealthWell Foundation, or their biosimilar manufacturer's independent PAP. NeedyMeds.org maintains an updated directory of all adalimumab assistance programs. Each biosimilar manufacturer runs its own PAP; ask your specialty pharmacy about the program for the specific product you are prescribed.
footnote.es: Las tarjetas de ahorros HUMIRA Complete y las tarjetas de copago del fabricante no pueden ser usadas por beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA. El estatuto federal anti-sobornos (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b) prohibe la asistencia de copago del fabricante para pacientes con seguro gubernamental. Los pacientes de Medicare deben buscar asistencia de PAN Foundation, HealthWell Foundation o el PAP independiente del fabricante del biosimilar.

patientAssistancePrograms.source: AbbVie.com, humira.com, panfoundation.org, healthwellfoundation.org, NeedyMeds.org, goodrx.com

paragraphs.en: Most Medicare patients receive adalimumab under Part B (provider-administered, billed with J0139), not Part D. If you self-administer biosimilar adalimumab at home and your Part D plan covers it, the 2026 annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100 established by the Inflation Reduction Act applies. There is no specific monthly Part D cap for adalimumab (unlike insulin's $35/month cap). By 2026, most Medicare Part D formularies have placed biosimilar adalimumab products on lower tiers (Tier 1 or Tier 2) and either excluded brand Humira or placed it at Tier 5 (specialty tier). An HHS OIG analysis of 2025 Medicare Part D plan formularies found broad adoption of adalimumab biosimilars across commercial plans.
paragraphs.es: La mayoria de los pacientes de Medicare reciben adalimumab bajo la Parte B (administrado por un proveedor), no la Parte D. Si se autoadministra adalimumab biosimilar en casa y su plan Parte D lo cubre, aplica el limite anual de gastos de bolsillo de 2026 de $2,100. No existe un limite mensual especifico de la Parte D para adalimumab (a diferencia del limite de $35/mes para insulina). Para 2026, la mayoria de los formularios Medicare Parte D han colocado los biosimilares de adalimumab en niveles mas bajos y han excluido Humira de marca o lo han colocado en el Nivel 5.

paragraphs.en: Patients approaching formulary tier assignment should check their plan's current drug list at Medicare.gov before filling a prescription, because a lower-tier biosimilar can mean hundreds of dollars less per month in cost-sharing. If your plan has assigned your prescribed adalimumab product to a higher formulary tier, you can request a formulary exception or appeal the tier assignment based on your prescriber's clinical justification. The Inflation Reduction Act also allows Medicare patients to pay up front on a monthly basis for Part D costs (smoothing), so a high monthly adalimumab bill can be spread evenly rather than hitting all at once in the deductible phase.
paragraphs.es: Los pacientes que se acercan a la asignacion de nivel de formulario deben verificar la lista de medicamentos actual de su plan en Medicare.gov antes de surtir una receta, porque un biosimilar de nivel mas bajo puede significar cientos de dolares menos por mes en comparticion de costos. Si su plan ha asignado su producto de adalimumab prescrito a un nivel de formulario mas alto, puede solicitar una excepcion de formulario o apelar la asignacion de nivel basandose en la justificacion clinica de su prescriptor.

intro.en: Adalimumab biosimilar switches introduce specific billing error risks beyond those seen with brand Humira. The HCPCS code change from J0135 to J0139 in January 2025, combined with multiple biosimilar products entering the market, creates multiple points of potential error on Explanations of Benefits and itemized bills:
intro.es: Los cambios a biosimilares de adalimumab introducen riesgos especificos de errores de facturacion. El cambio de codigo HCPCS de J0135 a J0139 en enero de 2025, combinado con multiples productos biosimilares en el mercado, crea multiples puntos de error potencial:

items.en: Stale J0135 code: Any claim for adalimumab (brand or biosimilar) with a date of service on or after January 1, 2025 using J0135 is using a deleted code. Request correction and resubmission with J0139.
items.es: Codigo J0135 obsoleto: Cualquier reclamacion de adalimumab con fecha de servicio el 1 de enero de 2025 o posterior que use J0135 usa un codigo eliminado. Solicite correccion y reenvio con J0139.

items.en: Wrong unit count for J0139: A 40mg dose = 40 units of J0139 (not 2 units). If the bill shows J0139 x 2 units, units are being billed as if J0135 units still applied. Verify: units billed times 1mg per unit must equal the total milligrams administered.
items.es: Conteo de unidades incorrecto para J0139: Una dosis de 40mg = 40 unidades de J0139 (no 2 unidades). Si la factura muestra J0139 x 2 unidades, se estan facturando como si todavia aplicaran las unidades de J0135.

items.en: Brand billed, biosimilar administered: Your EOB shows Humira charges but the pharmacy dispensed Hadlima, Hyrimoz, or another biosimilar. Each biosimilar has its own ASP rate; billing the brand rate when a biosimilar was dispensed is a billing error. The biosimilar's specific NDC and name should appear on the claim.
items.es: Marca facturada, biosimilar administrado: Su EOB muestra cargos de Humira pero la farmacia dispens o Hadlima, Hyrimoz u otro biosimilar. Cada biosimilar tiene su propia tarifa ASP; facturar la tarifa de la marca cuando se dispenso un biosimilar es un error.

items.en: Prior authorization mismatch after a biosimilar switch: Your plan approved Humira (or one biosimilar) but you were switched to a different biosimilar without updating the prior authorization. The new biosimilar may be denied. Always verify that your current PA reflects the specific product your pharmacy is dispensing.
items.es: Discrepancia de autorizacion previa despues de un cambio a biosimilar: Su plan aprobo Humira (o un biosimilar) pero fue cambiado a un biosimilar diferente sin actualizar la autorizacion previa. El nuevo biosimilar puede ser rechazado. Verifique siempre que su PA actual refleje el producto especifico que su farmacia dispensa.

items.en: Duplicate injection billing: Two line items for the same date of service when only one dose was administered. Check that each J0139 line item corresponds to a distinct injection date and distinct dose quantity.
items.es: Facturacion duplicada de inyeccion: Dos elementos de linea para la misma fecha de servicio cuando solo se administro una dosis. Verifique que cada elemento de linea J0139 corresponda a una fecha de inyeccion y cantidad de dosis distintas.

note.es: El adalimumab es un biologico, no un medicamento de molecula pequena, por lo que no existe un generico tradicional. appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written denial notice (Explanation of Benefits or denial letter) from your insurer. The notice must state the specific reason and your appeal rights.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito (Explicacion de Beneficios o carta de denegacion) de su asegurador. El aviso debe indicar el motivo especifico y sus derechos de apelacion.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: File a formal first-level appeal within your plan's deadline (typically 60 to 180 days from the denial date). Ask your rheumatologist, gastroenterologist, or dermatologist to submit a clinical justification letter documenting your diagnosis, prior treatments tried, contraindications, and medical necessity.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Presente una apelacion formal de primer nivel dentro del plazo de su plan (tipicamente 60 a 180 dias desde la fecha de denegacion). Solicite a su medico que presente una carta de justificacion clinica documentando su diagnostico, tratamientos previos, contraindicaciones y necesidad medica.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: If the first-level appeal is denied, request a peer-to-peer review, in which your prescriber speaks directly with the plan's medical director. This overturns about 30 to 40 percent of first-level denials for biologics based on prescriber data.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Si la apelacion de primer nivel es denegada, solicite una revision de par a par, donde su prescriptor habla directamente con el director medico del plan. Esto revierte alrededor del 30 al 40 por ciento de las denegaciones de primer nivel para biologicos.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: Escalate to an external independent review through your state Department of Insurance or state insurance commissioner. Medicare patients can escalate through the Medicare appeals process (Qualified Independent Contractor review) or request an ALJ hearing.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Escale a una revision independiente externa a traves del Departamento de Seguros de su estado. Los pacientes de Medicare pueden escalar a traves del proceso de apelaciones de Medicare o solicitar una audiencia ante un juez de derecho administrativo.

stepTherapyOverride.en: Most commercial and Medicaid plans require step therapy for biologics: you must fail a specified number of conventional DMARDs (such as methotrexate) or preferred biosimilars before the plan approves your prescribed adalimumab product. If you already tried and failed those required drugs, your prescriber can file a step-therapy override or prior authorization exception documenting the documented failure. Many states have enacted step therapy protection laws that require plans to approve overrides when clinical criteria are met. Ask your prescriber to document failure, intolerance, or contraindication for each step-therapy drug the plan requires.
stepTherapyOverride.es: La mayoria de los planes comerciales y Medicaid requieren terapia escalonada para biologicos: debe fallar un numero especificado de DMARDs convencionales o biosimilares preferidos antes de que el plan apruebe su producto de adalimumab prescrito. Si ya probo y fallo esos medicamentos requeridos, su prescriptor puede presentar una excepcion de terapia escalonada documentando el fallo. Muchos estados han promulgado leyes de proteccion de terapia escalonada.

papFallback.en: If all appeals fail and you cannot afford the drug, apply to the biosimilar manufacturer's patient assistance program for the specific biosimilar your prescriber has prescribed. Boehringer Ingelheim's unbranded adalimumab-adbm is available through GoodRx at approximately $550/month for cash-paying patients with no income requirement. For patients with incomes below 600% FPL who do not have insurance coverage, the original myAbbVie Assist PAP remains available only for existing enrolled patients; new patients should apply to the relevant biosimilar manufacturer's PAP or to independent foundations (PAN Foundation, HealthWell Foundation) for grant assistance.
papFallback.es: Si todas las apelaciones fallan y no puede pagar el medicamento, solicite el programa de asistencia al paciente del fabricante del biosimilar para el biosimilar especifico que su prescriptor ha recetado. El adalimumab-adbm sin marca de Boehringer Ingelheim esta disponible a traves de GoodRx a aproximadamente $550/mes para pacientes que pagan en efectivo sin requisito de ingresos.

genericAlternative.en: No traditional generic exists for adalimumab because it is a biologic. However, all eight FDA-approved biosimilars carry the interchangeable designation in 2026, with cash prices 80 to 92 percent below Humira's list price. The lowest-cost options are unbranded adalimumab-adbm via GoodRx (approximately $550/month) and Yusimry (approximately $639/month). Discuss biosimilar options with your rheumatologist, gastroenterologist, or dermatologist; interchangeable biosimilars have the same indications, safety, and efficacy profile as reference Humira.
genericAlternative.es: No existe un generico tradicional para el adalimumab porque es un biologico. Sin embargo, los ocho biosimilares aprobados por la FDA llevan la designacion de intercambiable en 2026, con precios en efectivo del 80 al 92 por ciento por debajo del precio de lista de Humira. Las opciones de menor costo son adalimumab-adbm sin marca via GoodRx (aproximadamente $550/mes) y Yusimry (aproximadamente $639/mes).

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: For new patients starting adalimumab in 2026: Ask your prescriber which FDA-approved biosimilar they recommend. Obtain a prescription for that specific biosimilar product. Each biosimilar manufacturer runs its own assistance program; your specialty pharmacy can connect you to the correct program for the product you have been prescribed.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Para nuevos pacientes que inician adalimumab en 2026: Pregunte a su prescriptor que biosimilar aprobado por la FDA recomienda. Obtenga una receta para ese producto biosimilar especifico. Cada fabricante de biosimilar tiene su propio programa de asistencia.

Manufacturer PAPs generally require Extra Help denial or enrollment confirmation before processing Medicare patient applications. Medicare patients also qualify for independent copay grants from PAN Foundation (panfoundation.org) and HealthWell Foundation (healthwellfoundation.org).

Los pacientes de Medicare tambien califican para subvenciones independientes de copago de PAN Foundation y HealthWell Foundation.

en.question: Is there a generic for Humira in 2026?
en.answer: No traditional generic exists for Humira because adalimumab is a biologic, not a small-molecule drug. The generic pathway (ANDA at FDA) does not apply. Instead, eight FDA-approved biosimilars are on the market in 2026: Amjevita, Cyltezo, Hadlima, Hulio, Hyrimoz, Simlandi, Yuflyma, and Abrilada. All eight are interchangeable, meaning pharmacists can substitute them for Humira without a new prescription in most states. The cheapest option is unbranded adalimumab-adbm via GoodRx at approximately $550 per month, a 92 percent discount from Humira's $6,922 list price.

en.question: What are the 8 FDA-approved Humira biosimilar alternatives in 2026?
en.answer: The eight actively marketed adalimumab biosimilars in 2026 are: Amjevita (adalimumab-atto, Amgen), Cyltezo (adalimumab-adbm, Boehringer Ingelheim), Hadlima (adalimumab-bwwd, Organon), Hulio (adalimumab-fkjp, Mylan/Fujifilm), Hyrimoz (adalimumab-adaz, Sandoz), Simlandi (adalimumab-ryvk, Alvotech), Yuflyma (adalimumab-aaty, Celltrion), and Abrilada (adalimumab-afzb, Pfizer). All eight carry the FDA interchangeable designation; Abrilada received its designation on October 5, 2023. All share Humira's indications for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, plaque psoriasis, and related conditions.

en.question: How do I apply for the patient assistance program for Humira or its biosimilars?
en.answer: AbbVie's myAbbVie Assist program stopped accepting new Humira applications on July 1, 2026. For new patients, apply to the biosimilar manufacturer's PAP: Boehringer Ingelheim offers unbranded adalimumab-adbm via GoodRx at approximately $550/month with no income requirement; Organon (Hadlima) has a patient support program at hadlima.com; Coherus (Yusimry) has assistance at coherus.com. For Medicare patients, PAN Foundation (panfoundation.org) and HealthWell Foundation (healthwellfoundation.org) offer independent copay grants. Gather proof of income, proof of US residency, a valid prescription, and insurance documentation before applying.

en.question: Can I use the HUMIRA Complete savings card with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback statute (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b) prohibits manufacturers from offering copay assistance to patients enrolled in Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA programs. HUMIRA Complete is explicitly limited to commercially insured patients and contains language stating it is not valid with any federal or state government insurance program. Medicare patients with adalimumab cost-sharing concerns should apply to PAN Foundation or HealthWell Foundation for independent copay grants, or explore biosimilar options available at far lower cash prices than brand Humira.

en.question: What does Humira cost without insurance at the pharmacy counter in 2026?
en.answer: Humira's list price is $6,922 per month for a standard 2-pen carton in 2026. No patient should pay this unless they have no other options. Biosimilar alternatives are dramatically cheaper: unbranded adalimumab-adbm costs approximately $550 per month via GoodRx (92 percent discount); Yusimry runs approximately $639; Hadlima approximately $1,038; Yuflyma approximately $1,043. If you have commercial insurance, the HUMIRA Complete savings card can reduce your copay to $0 per month.

en.question: What if my insurance denies coverage for Humira or a biosimilar in 2026?
en.answer: Start by requesting a written denial letter specifying the exact reason. Most denials involve prior authorization requirements or step therapy (requiring trial of methotrexate or a preferred biosimilar first). Your prescriber should file a peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director, which overturns roughly 30 to 40 percent of biologic denials. If the appeal fails, ask for an external independent review through your state Department of Insurance. As a parallel track, apply for the relevant manufacturer's patient assistance program for the specific biosimilar prescribed, or seek an independent copay grant from PAN Foundation or HealthWell Foundation.

en.question: Does the IRA negotiated price apply to Humira or its biosimilars?
en.answer: No. Humira (adalimumab) is not one of the 10 drugs in the first round of Medicare drug price negotiation under the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022. Those 10 drugs (Eliquis, Jardiance, Xarelto, Januvia, Farxiga, Entresto, Enbrel, Imbruvica, Stelara, and insulin aspart formulations) have Maximum Fair Prices effective January 1, 2026. Humira is not on that list. However, the IRA's $2,100 annual Medicare Part D out-of-pocket cap still applies to adalimumab for Part D patients in 2026, which significantly reduces exposure compared to prior years when patients could face unlimited cost-sharing in the catastrophic phase.

en.question: Do I qualify for a patient assistance program for Humira biosimilars?
en.answer: Eligibility criteria vary by manufacturer. myAbbVie Assist for Humira used a 600% FPL income threshold (approximately $95,760 per year for a single-person household in 2026) but closed to new Humira applicants on July 1, 2026. Boehringer Ingelheim's unbranded adalimumab-adbm through GoodRx has no income requirement and is available to cash-paying patients at approximately $550/month. PAN Foundation and HealthWell Foundation assist Medicare patients based on income and disease criteria. Non-income requirements across most programs include US residency, a valid prescription, and limited or no prescription drug coverage for the specific product applied for.

es.question: ¿Existe un generico para Humira en 2026?
es.answer: No existe un generico tradicional para Humira porque el adalimumab es un biologico, no un medicamento de molecula pequena. En cambio, ocho biosimilares aprobados por la FDA estan en el mercado en 2026: Amjevita, Cyltezo, Hadlima, Hulio, Hyrimoz, Simlandi, Yuflyma y Abrilada. Los ocho son intercambiables, lo que significa que los farmaceuticos pueden sustituirlos por Humira sin una nueva receta en la mayoria de los estados. La opcion mas barata es adalimumab-adbm sin marca via GoodRx a aproximadamente $550 por mes, un descuento del 92% frente al precio de lista de $6,922 de Humira.

es.question: ¿Cuales son los 8 biosimilares alternativos de Humira aprobados por la FDA en 2026?
es.answer: Los ocho biosimilares de adalimumab activamente comercializados en 2026 son: Amjevita (adalimumab-atto, Amgen), Cyltezo (adalimumab-adbm, Boehringer Ingelheim), Hadlima (adalimumab-bwwd, Organon), Hulio (adalimumab-fkjp, Mylan/Fujifilm), Hyrimoz (adalimumab-adaz, Sandoz), Simlandi (adalimumab-ryvk, Alvotech), Yuflyma (adalimumab-aaty, Celltrion) y Abrilada (adalimumab-afzb, Pfizer). Los ocho llevan la designacion de intercambiable de la FDA; Abrilada recibio su designacion el 5 de octubre de 2023. Todos comparten las indicaciones de Humira para artritis reumatoide, artritis psoriasica, espondilitis anquilosante, enfermedad de Crohn, colitis ulcerosa, psoriasis en placas y condiciones relacionadas.

es.question: ¿Como solicito el programa de asistencia al paciente para Humira o sus biosimilares?
es.answer: El programa myAbbVie Assist de AbbVie dejo de aceptar nuevas solicitudes de Humira el 1 de julio de 2026. Para nuevos pacientes, solicite el PAP del fabricante del biosimilar: Boehringer Ingelheim ofrece adalimumab-adbm sin marca a traves de GoodRx a aproximadamente $550/mes sin requisito de ingresos; Organon (Hadlima) tiene un programa de apoyo en hadlima.com; Coherus (Yusimry) tiene asistencia en coherus.com. Para pacientes de Medicare, PAN Foundation y HealthWell Foundation ofrecen subvenciones independientes de copago. Reuna comprobante de ingresos, residencia en EE.UU., receta valida y documentacion de seguro antes de solicitar.

es.question: ¿Puedo usar la tarjeta de ahorros HUMIRA Complete con Medicare?
es.answer: No. El estatuto federal anti-sobornos (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7b) prohibe a los fabricantes ofrecer asistencia de copago a pacientes inscritos en Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA. HUMIRA Complete esta explicitamente limitada a pacientes con seguro comercial. Los pacientes de Medicare con preocupaciones sobre los costos de comparticion de adalimumab deben solicitar a PAN Foundation o HealthWell Foundation subvenciones independientes de copago, o explorar opciones de biosimilares disponibles a precios en efectivo mucho mas bajos.

es.question: ¿Cuanto cuesta Humira sin seguro en la farmacia en 2026?
es.answer: El precio de lista de Humira es $6,922 por mes para un carton estandar de 2 plumas en 2026. Ningun paciente deberia pagar esto si tiene otras opciones. Las alternativas biosimilares son dramaticamente mas baratas: adalimumab-adbm sin marca cuesta aproximadamente $550 por mes via GoodRx (descuento del 92%); Yusimry aproximadamente $639; Hadlima aproximadamente $1,038; Yuflyma aproximadamente $1,043. Si tiene seguro comercial, la tarjeta de ahorros HUMIRA Complete puede reducir su copago a $0 por mes.

es.question: ¿Que pasa si mi seguro niega la cobertura de Humira o un biosimilar en 2026?
es.answer: Comience solicitando una carta de denegacion por escrito que especifique el motivo exacto. La mayoria de las denegaciones implican requisitos de autorizacion previa o terapia escalonada. Su prescriptor debe solicitar una revision de par a par con el director medico del plan, lo que revierte aproximadamente el 30 al 40 por ciento de las denegaciones de biologicos. Si la apelacion falla, solicite una revision independiente externa a traves del Departamento de Seguros de su estado. Como pista paralela, solicite el programa de asistencia al paciente del fabricante del biosimilar recetado, o busque una subvenciones de copago independiente de PAN Foundation o HealthWell Foundation.

es.question: ¿Se aplica el precio negociado de la IRA a Humira o sus biosimilares?
es.answer: No. Humira (adalimumab) no es uno de los 10 medicamentos en la primera ronda de negociacion de precios de medicamentos de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022. Sin embargo, el limite anual de gastos de bolsillo de $2,100 de Medicare Parte D de la IRA si aplica al adalimumab para pacientes de la Parte D en 2026, lo que reduce significativamente la exposicion en comparacion con anos anteriores cuando los pacientes podian enfrentar una comparticion de costos ilimitada en la fase catastrofica.

es.question: ¿Califico para un programa de asistencia al paciente para biosimilares de Humira?
es.answer: Los criterios de elegibilidad varian segun el fabricante. myAbbVie Assist para Humira usaba un umbral de ingresos del 600% FPL (aproximadamente $95,760 por ano para un hogar de una persona en 2026) pero cerro a nuevos solicitantes el 1 de julio de 2026. El adalimumab-adbm sin marca de Boehringer Ingelheim a traves de GoodRx no tiene requisito de ingresos y esta disponible para pacientes que pagan en efectivo a aproximadamente $550/mes. Los requisitos no relacionados con ingresos en la mayoria de los programas incluyen residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida y cobertura limitada o nula del medicamento especifico.
